discovery.rule: Do not label third-party compilations as authentic past JLPT exams without provenance

rightsNotes: JLPT organizers do not release each full past test; the official workbooks hold real questions without naming their session
jlpt.jp site policy 1(4) pre-grants copying for free Japanese teaching material when the source is credited next to it; 1(5) asks for permission otherwise
Listening audio of N1–N5 and some N1/N2 reading passages contain third-party works: no copying without separate permission; links are welcome, embedding is not

Month/year-labelled papers on other sites are unofficial reconstructions; their terms forbid scraping and the JLPT notice of 2024-01-19 warns against using leaked questions (docs/testing/jlpt-official-sources-2026-11-11.md)

official2012and2018.verification: Official listing verified; individual media file download/integrity not verified

pastExam2022to2026.verification: No authenticated complete public past-exam bundles identified; third-party uploads not treated as authentic

copyright.policy: Reference and catalog only; do not mirror question PDFs, answer keys or MP3s without permission
